sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values
sources.licence: project contribution under the repository's terms

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium pensylvanicum, plant_name_id 279888.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

generator.params.note: Its one or two flowers stand together at the stem's tip (Flora of China: flowers 1 or 2(-6)), drawn as a raceme a thirtieth of the stem long.

allometry.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stem (30-)50-70(-120) cm; Wikipedia 'Lilium pensylvanicum': 30-70 cm. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 0.6 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stem (30-)50-70(-120) cm; Wikipedia 'Lilium pensylvanicum': 30-70 cm.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves scattered plus 4 or 5 in a whorl at apex of stem.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 4-5 cm x 3-4(-25) mm; Wikipedia the same.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 3-4(-25) mm wide.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves sessile, linear, rarely to lanceolate.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers 1 or 2(-6); Wikipedia: one to six.

traits.flower_posture.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium pensylvanicum' (read 2026-10-18): one to six upright, dish-shaped flowers.

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium pensylvanicum' (read 2026-10-18): six tepals curving backward from the center.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): tepals vermilion or red. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): with purple-red spots, rarely with yellow claws.

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): purple-red spots. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): outer tepals (3-)7-9 x 1.5-2.3 cm, inner slightly narrower.

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stamens converging; filaments ca. 5 cm, anthers ca. 1 cm, short of tepals 7-9 cm.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsule oblong, ca. 5 x 3 cm.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsule ca. 3 cm wide.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowering Jun-Jul; Wikipedia: June and July.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium dauricum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): fruit Aug-Sep.
